newsitem.title: USA: Geographics Inc stake held by WisdomTree.
newsitem.headline: Geographics Inc stake held by WisdomTree.

text.p: A group including WisdomTree Capital Management Inc said Wednesday it holds a 5.4 percent stake in Geographics Inc or 506,300 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake in the Blaine, Washington, based company between Nov 12 and Nov 15 at prices ranging from $2.85 to $2.87 per share.

Geographics is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing and distribution of design stationery, value added papers, lettering, signage, stencil and graphic art products in U.S., Canada, Australia, Europe, Israel and Mexico.
